SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
[FI] I'm opening the door, but... you won't do anything 
strange?

[FI] I can't understand if you stay silent... is what I 
wanted to say, but.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Hey, hey. I doubt it's nothing.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] ...Yes, but... I won't talk about it after all.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Perhaps we're both worried about the same thing.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] ...Are you really worried about what I'm thinking?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] We won't know unless we talk more about it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ......Somehow, it's embarrassing to put it into words.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
[FI] What's with that? It's really annoying when you 
start speaking and stop all of a sudden.
[FI] The pot calling the kettle black.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Can I have a Life Consultation with you?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] You've let me consult with you many times, after all.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] You... said that I've been acting obedient lately, 
right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] We were on bad terms for a long time, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] But, recently we've gotten along better.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] We always quarrel, but it's not like way back when 
we ignore each other, not speaking at all.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] And yet. We found out that we aren't related by 
blood.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] You interacted with me just like always, but...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] It wasn't easy for us to get along, but for us to 
grow apart over what we found out... I don't want 
that.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] I don't care if you make fun of me. I was prepared 
for that even before I told you all of this.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I just wanted to tell you how I really feel.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Sure, we might not be related by blood.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Even so, please stay as my little sister.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] That is... what the Life Consultation is about, from 
me to you.

[FI] Having heard my words, Kirino... remained silent for 
a while, and then slowly moved her lips to speak.

[FI] I would've never expected that after pouring my 
heart out, she would reply like that.

[FI] Kirino didn't answer my question immediately, and 
instead said this.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
[FI] ...I also have something to ask you. A Life 
Consultation.
[FI] I had no choice but to nod.

[FI] I believed the reason for her reply lay at the end of 
this talk.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
[FI] That's why... I don't want to be "just your little 
sister".
[FI] The Final Life Consultation from Kirino.

[FI] It was something that would've made me confused 
and panicked if Kirino were my real little sister--

[FI] I wonder how I would respond if I didn't know the 
truth? I'm not sure.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] That kind of option is also possible now.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
[FI] Finding out about not being related by blood 
midway... If this was a game, I would return it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Hah... Don't put games and reality together.

[FI] To our respective Life Consultations, this was the 
perfect answer.

[FI] We'd always been distant until now, and suddenly 
our relationship was restored.
[FI] And it's possible now that we know the truth--

[FI] With just a small misunderstanding, with just one 
wrong decision.
[FI] Things surely wouldn't have turned out like this.
[FI] By a miraculous chance, we became lovers.
